entities.name: The Hoarder
entities.intro: Something in Quadrant C has been stacking crates into walls, and the walls are getting closer together.

facts.text: It nests behind the crate wall it builds, and it builds every night.
It cannot see red. The System considers this fair warning.
It keeps a tally of everything taken from its floor. The tally is long.

entities.name: Mother of Pipes
entities.intro: The Meat District's drains answer to something, and it is not the drains.

facts.text: The pipes are not plumbing. They are the mouth.
It seeds a new district every time the water runs clear.

entities.name: The Tollkeeper
entities.intro: It sits at the only stair down and it has never once been in a hurry.

facts.text: The toll is measured in names, and it always gets the price it names.
It counts aloud. Crawlers who reach zero do not reach the stair.
The stair is a bridge. The Tollkeeper is what holds it up.

entities.name: Grull Industries Representative
entities.intro: A licensed window in the wall. It sells, it smiles, and it files a report either way.

facts.text: It has a quota. The quota is not in credits.
Every deal carries terms. The terms are read out after the deal.
The window follows the party down a floor exactly once.

entities.name: Ghaza Provisioner
entities.intro: Sells crawler life insurance out of a cart. Terms apply posthumously.

facts.text: The cart carries whatever the last customer failed to need.
Premiums rise the moment a crawler reads the policy.
The fine print is broadcast. Nobody has ever asked for it to be read.

entities.name: Quartermaster Vel
entities.intro: Keeps the ledger of everything this floor still owes, and lends against it.

facts.text: Vel never forgives a debt. Vel defers one, at interest.
Vel walks the same route nightly, and notices what has moved.

entities.name: The Lamplighter
entities.intro: Lights the stair lamps ahead of the party and asks for nothing, which is itself alarming.

facts.text: A lit lamp means the sector has been walked and found survivable.
The route is fixed. The Lamplighter will not be argued off it.
Every lamp goes out at once, once per floor. That is the curfew.

entities.name: The Signal Choir
entities.intro: A faction of crawlers who hold a frequency open so the rest of the floor can hear itself think.

facts.text: The frequency is held by voice. Someone is always singing.
The hymn names every crawler the floor has lost, in order.
